chapters.reason: The paper's core finding is that intermediate layers encode richer representations and improve downstream task performance, directly aligning with the description of intermediate layers forming the core of latent reasoning and specialized computational sub-circuits.

The study analyzes the distinct computational roles and representation quality of different layers, examining how they integrate and transmit information, which matches the micro-level observation of functional differentiation across depths.

The paper contrasts intermediate layers with earlier (shallow) layers, which are described as handling basic representational processing, consistent with the analysis of layer-wise representation properties.
